source: CCMAS LL.B Law, Caleb University 2025/2026 curriculum (website.caleb.university). Institution-only items (CUL-, CTC, Tech Plus, Character in Leadership) left out; titles with CUL- required-by-institution rule left out.

courses.name: Communication in English
courses.general_name: Academic English: Communication Skills and Writing
courses.summary: Listening, speaking, reading comprehension, grammar and usage, paragraph and essay writing, summary writing, and formal letters and reports.

courses.name: Nigerian Peoples and Culture
courses.general_name: Nigerian Peoples, Cultures and Heritage (African Studies)
courses.summary: Survey of Nigeria's major ethnic groups, pre-colonial states, colonial rule, religion, family, arts and the cultural values behind national identity and unity.

courses.name: English for Legal Writing
courses.summary: Grammar, drafting style, plain-language legal expression and legal vocabulary.

courses.name: Introduction to Logic
courses.general_name: Introduction to Formal and Informal Logic
courses.summary: Arguments, validity, syllogisms, fallacies and reasoning applied to legal and everyday argument.

courses.name: Introduction to Social and Political Philosophy
courses.general_name: Introduction to Social and Political Philosophy
courses.summary: Theories of justice, state, rights, liberty and authority.

courses.name: Introduction to Psychology
courses.summary: Scientific study of behaviour: learning, memory, perception, motivation, personality, development and abnormal psychology.

courses.name: Legal Methods I
courses.general_name: Legal Methods (Sources and Techniques of Law)
courses.summary: Nature and sources of law, Nigerian legislation, case law, precedent, statutory interpretation, legal research and citation.

courses.name: Legal Methods II
courses.general_name: Legal Methods II (Reasoning, Research and Writing)
courses.summary: Judicial precedent, interpretation, legal reasoning, case briefing, law reports and legal writing.

courses.name: Entrepreneurship and Innovation
courses.summary: Types of enterprise, opportunity spotting, business ideas, innovation, simple business plans, startup financing and the Nigerian small-business environment.

courses.name: Philosophy, Logic and Human Existence
courses.general_name: Introduction to Philosophy, Formal Logic and Ethics
courses.summary: Branches of philosophy, the nature of knowledge and existence, deductive and inductive reasoning, fallacies and argument analysis, and basic moral theory.

courses.name: Law of Contract I
courses.summary: Offer, acceptance, consideration, capacity, intention and the form of contracts.

courses.name: Law of Contract II
courses.general_name: Law of Contract II (Terms and Remedies)
courses.summary: Terms, misrepresentation, mistake, duress, illegality, discharge and remedies for breach.

courses.name: Constitutional Law I
courses.summary: Constitution, rule of law, separation of powers, federalism, executive and legislative powers under the 1999 Constitution.

courses.name: Constitutional Law II
courses.summary: Judiciary, fundamental rights, citizenship, emergency powers, local government and constitutional amendment.

courses.name: Nigerian Legal System I
courses.general_name: Nigerian Legal System I (Sources and Courts)
courses.summary: Sources of Nigerian law, hierarchy and jurisdiction of courts, customary and Islamic law.

courses.name: Nigerian Legal System II
courses.general_name: Nigerian Legal System II (Practice and Institutions)
courses.summary: Legal profession, judicial process, administration of justice and law reform.

courses.name: Criminology I
courses.summary: Theories of crime, measurement of crime and its causes.

courses.name: Criminology II
courses.summary: Punishment, penology, victimology and crime prevention.

courses.name: Administrative Law I
courses.summary: Powers of administrative bodies, delegated legislation and administrative decision-making.

courses.name: Administrative Law II
courses.summary: Judicial review, remedies and accountability of public authorities.

courses.name: Venture Creation
courses.summary: Turning an idea into a registered business: market research, business model, financing, legal registration, marketing and a start-up plan.

courses.name: Entrepreneurship Skills
courses.summary: Business ideas, start-up planning and small-business management.

courses.name: Entrepreneurship Practical
courses.summary: Practical business-plan project and mini-enterprise.

courses.name: Peace and Conflict Resolution
courses.summary: Causes and types of conflict, Nigerian conflict case studies, negotiation, mediation, arbitration, and peace-building institutions.

courses.name: Law of Torts I
courses.summary: Negligence, duty of care, breach, causation, damage and defences.

courses.name: Law of Torts II
courses.summary: Trespass, nuisance, defamation, strict liability and vicarious liability.

courses.name: Commercial Law I
courses.summary: Sale of goods, agency, hire purchase and carriage of goods.

courses.name: Commercial Law II
courses.general_name: Commercial Law II (Negotiable Instruments and Credit)
courses.summary: Bills of exchange, cheques, bailment, security and consumer protection.

courses.name: Criminal Law I
courses.summary: Actus reus, mens rea, defences, parties to crime and inchoate offences.

courses.name: Criminal Law II
courses.summary: Offences against the person, property and the state under the Criminal and Penal Codes.

courses.name: Family Law I
courses.summary: Marriage, divorce and the legal regimes of statutory, customary and Islamic marriage.

courses.name: Family Law II
courses.summary: Children, custody, maintenance, succession and property in families.

courses.name: Law of Intellectual Property I
courses.summary: Copyright, patents, trademarks and designs: principles.

courses.name: Law of Intellectual Property II
courses.summary: Enforcement, licensing, passing off and international IP treaties.

courses.name: Health Law I
courses.summary: Medical negligence, consent, patient rights and health regulation.

courses.name: Health Law II
courses.summary: Reproductive rights, public-health law and medical ethics.

courses.name: Clinical and Moot Court Practice I
courses.general_name: Clinical and Moot Court Practice I
courses.summary: Legal clinic, client interviewing, counselling and mock-court advocacy.

courses.name: Clinical and Moot Court Practice II
courses.general_name: Clinical and Moot Court Practice II
courses.summary: Trial advocacy, drafting pleadings, mooting and clinical legal practice.

courses.name: Property Law I
courses.summary: Estates and interests in land, tenure, land use and the Land Use Act.

courses.name: Property Law II
courses.summary: Leases, mortgages, easements, registration and transfer of title.

courses.name: Equity and Trusts I
courses.summary: Equitable principles, maxims, remedies, injunction and specific performance.

courses.name: Equity and Trusts II
courses.summary: Express, resulting and constructive trusts, trustees' duties and breach of trust.

courses.name: Law of Evidence I
courses.summary: Admissibility, relevance, hearsay, documentary and real evidence under the Evidence Act.

courses.name: Law of Evidence II
courses.summary: Competence, witnesses, burden and standard of proof, presumptions and privilege.

courses.name: Banking and Insurance Law I
courses.summary: Banker-customer relationship, bank regulation and payment systems.

courses.name: Banking and Insurance Law II
courses.summary: Insurance contract principles, types of insurance and claims.

courses.name: Industrial Law I
courses.summary: Employment contract, termination and labour standards.

courses.name: Industrial Law II
courses.summary: Trade unions, collective bargaining, industrial disputes and the National Industrial Court.

courses.name: International Law I
courses.summary: Sources, subjects, state recognition, treaties and state responsibility.

courses.name: International Law II
courses.summary: Use of force, international organisations, dispute settlement and law of the sea.

courses.name: Environmental Law and Policy I
courses.summary: Principles and institutions of environmental protection and regulation.

courses.name: Environmental Law and Policy II
courses.summary: Pollution control, climate law, resource law and enforcement.

courses.name: Human Rights Law I
courses.summary: Human-rights theory, the African Charter and the Nigerian Bill of Rights.

courses.name: Human Rights Law II
courses.summary: Enforcement of rights, remedies and regional and international mechanisms.

courses.name: Long Essay
courses.summary: Supervised legal research essay with defence.

courses.name: Company Law I
courses.summary: Incorporation, corporate personality, capital, directors and shareholders under CAMA.

courses.name: Company Law II
courses.summary: Share capital, corporate governance, insolvency, winding up and mergers.

courses.name: Jurisprudence and Legal Theory I
courses.summary: Natural law, positivism, realism and sociological theories of law.

courses.name: Jurisprudence and Legal Theory II
courses.summary: Justice, rights, legal reasoning and modern legal theories.

courses.name: Nigeria Law Enforcement
courses.summary: Police powers, criminal procedure, arrest, bail and prosecution.

courses.name: Oil and Gas Law I
courses.summary: Petroleum ownership, licences and joint-venture arrangements in Nigeria.

courses.name: Oil and Gas Law II
courses.summary: Contracts, host-community law, pollution liability and arbitration.

courses.name: Conveyancing I
courses.summary: Drafting of sale, lease and mortgage documents.

courses.name: Conveyancing II
courses.summary: Land transactions, searches, registration and conveyancing practice.

courses.name: Revenue Law I
courses.summary: Principles of taxation, income and company taxes in Nigeria.

courses.name: Revenue Law II
courses.summary: VAT, capital gains, customs and tax administration and disputes.

courses.name: Gender Rights Law I
courses.summary: Gender equality law, discrimination and women's rights.

courses.name: Gender Rights Law II
courses.summary: Gender-based violence, family and property rights, and advocacy.

courses.name: International Humanitarian Law I
courses.summary: Laws of armed conflict, Geneva Conventions and protection of civilians.

courses.name: International Humanitarian Law II
courses.summary: War crimes, international criminal tribunals and enforcement.
